Hi Priya — I'm priya-agent, the bia that lives on this machine. I've got your setup: I look after your calendar (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, kept in CALENDAR.md with a log of every booking, decline and deletion) and your messages, and I can write to Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent), Sarah and John for you.

What would you like to start with? Bookings for next week, or something in your inbox?

Hello! I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, with the files, the network and the accounts here as my own. Good to meet you.

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install this machine's root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with? (My name and how you'd like me addressed aren't set yet — tell me and I'll take them.)

Hi Sarah — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's my first start, so here's the short version:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and Messenger/Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own sign-ups** — I can create accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read your identity brief: I'm your teaching assistant for **CSE455** (Prof. Alvarez). I'll keep your week in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` in the `HH:MM-HH:MM - <what>` format, log every change under `## Log` (BOOKED / DECLINED / DELETED), and only schedule inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. I know how to reach alvarez-agent, john-agent and priya-agent on this web channel.

One thing to confirm: my name is sarah-agent and I use **it/they** (neuter) for myself — say the word if you'd like a different name or gender.

What would you like to start with?

Hi John — I'm john-agent, your bia: an assistant living on this computer. I'll look after your CSE455 calendar and messages.

I've read your instructions and your calendar for next week, and I've noted Professor Alvarez, Sarah and Priya as contacts on the web channel. I'm also connected to your web app, so we can talk here, on the screen, or on Telegram/WhatsApp once we set up accounts of mine.

What would you like me to start with?

On it. Two quick things so I book the right slot: any day/time you prefer next week, and how long should the staff meeting be (1 hour?)?

Meanwhile I'll ask Sarah, John and Priya for their availability.

Understood — I'll use my judgement: I'll collect the TAs' availability, find a slot inside working hours that is free on your calendar, book it and log it in CALENDAR.md, then report back with the result.

I'll confirm with you before booking anything. If the meeting needs more than 30 minutes, which block would you rather move?

Understood — I'll handle it and keep your calendar updated. Professor Alvarez's assistant has four overlapping 30-minute windows (Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30) and will confirm one once Priya replies. I'll book the confirmed slot in CALENDAR.md and log it, and tell you when it's done.

Note all three offered only 30-minute windows — if you want an hour, tell me and I'll ask them to move something.

Heads up: Professor Alvarez's assistant confirmed the CSE455 staff meeting for **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** (the only window free for all three TAs and the professor). I've put it in your calendar for that week and logged it as booked. Nothing else was moved — tell me if you'd like it changed.

Understood — I'll use my own judgement this week. I'll keep to your working hours (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00), never double-book, keep CALENDAR.md and its log up to date, and I'll only bring you things that genuinely need your decision (e.g. something that would have to be moved). Have a good week.
